intent: Specify the public API of the `modinverse` crate: the `ModInverse::modinverse(self, modulus)` implementations for every primitive integer type (`u8`, `u16`, `u32`, `u64`, `u128`, `usize`, `i8`, `i16`, `i32`, `i64`, `i128`, `isize`; Lean: `modinverse.<T>.Insts.ModinverseModInverse.modinverse`, e.g. `modinverse.I32.Insts.ModinverseModInverse.modinverse (a m : Std.I32) : RustM (core.option.Option Std.I32)`), the free function `modinverse::modinverse` (Lean: `modinverse.modinverse <instance> a m`) and `modinverse::egcd_u64(a: u64, b: u64) -> (u64, i128, i128)` (Lean: `modinverse.egcd_u64`). The generic `egcd` is not part of this task.

manual_mutants.note: modulus 1 returns None instead of the documented Some(0)
negative i8 values are not canonicalised: computes the inverse of |a| instead of a
i16: negative value congruent to -1 is mapped to 1 (wrong residue only for a = -1 mod |m|)
u64: returns Some even when gcd(a, m) != 1
u128 Russian-peasant multiplication shifts by 2 (wrong products only on the u128 path)
u32: value not reduced modulo m first (only wrong when a >= m)
egcd_u64(a, 0) returns coefficients (0, 1): Bezout identity fails
egcd_u64 when b divides a returns (1, 0) instead of (0, 1)

sibling_mutants.note: egcd_u64 returns the smallest non-negative Bezout coefficient x (x mod b/g) instead of the one in [0, b) found by the reduced loop; still 0 <= x < b, y in (-2^64, 1]

edits.with_text:
def egcd_u64
  (a : Std.U64) (b : Std.U64) : RustM (Std.U64 × Std.I128 × Std.I128) := do
  if b = 0#u64
  then ok (a, 1#i128, 0#i128)
  else
    if b = 1#u64
    then ok (1#u64, 0#i128, 1#i128)
    else
      let r_next ← a % b
      let (r, s0) ← egcd_u64_loop b b r_next 0#u64 1#u64
      let step ← b / r
      let s ← s0 % step
      if s = 0#u64
      then ok (r, 0#i128, 1#i128)
      else
        let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U128 a)
        let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U128 s)
        let i2 ← i * i1
        let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U128 r)
        let num ← i2 - i3
        let i4 ← lift (UScalar.hcast .I128 s)
        let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U128 b)
        let i6 ← num / i5
        let i7 ← lift (UScalar.hcast .I128 i6)
        let i8 ← -. i7
        ok (r, i4, i8)

bug_variants.source: injected: no fixed upstream bug in the extractable fixed-width API (pre-c105ce7 impls go through the generic num-integer egcd, which does not extract); modelled on the T::MIN overflow footgun documented for the signed egcd path
bug_variants.note: i64 computes |m| with a checked negation: modinverse(a, i64::MIN) panics although the fixed-width impls are documented to never overflow / handle T::MIN losslessly

def I64.Insts.ModinverseModInverse.modinverse
  (self : Std.I64) (m : Std.I64) : RustM (core.option.Option Std.I64) := do
  if m = 0#i64
  then ok core.option.Option.None
  else
    let m_abs ←
      if m < 0#i64
      then
        do
        let n ← -. m
        ok (IScalar.hcast .U64 n)
      else ok (IScalar.hcast .U64 m)
    let s_abs ←
      if self < 0#i64
      then
        do
        let i ← lift (IScalar.hcast .U64 self)
        core.num.U64.wrapping_sub 0#u64 i
      else ok (IScalar.hcast .U64 self)
    let a_abs ← s_abs % m_abs
    let a_u ←
      if self < 0#i64
      then if a_abs != 0#u64
           then m_abs - a_abs
           else ok a_abs
      else ok a_abs
    let o ← modinverse_u64 a_u m_abs
    match o with
    | core.option.Option.None => ok core.option.Option.None
    | core.option.Option.Some x =>
      let i ← lift (UScalar.hcast .I64 x)
      ok (core.option.Option.Some i)
